block.microsoft_365.model.title: Microsoft 365
block.microsoft_365.model.description: Work with Outlook mail and calendar, OneDrive files and Teams messages.
block.microsoft_365.security_hint: The OAuth grant stays in the wallet. Nothing is changed until Allow writes is enabled, and nothing is sent to people until Allow sending is enabled.
block.microsoft_365.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.microsoft_365.invalid_number: Check the numeric value and its limits.
block.microsoft_365.help_enabled: Off by default. While off, no request reaches Microsoft and the wallet is never read.
block.microsoft_365.help_secret_ref: Wallet reference holding JSON with client_id and refresh_token (plus client_secret for a confidential app), or an access token. Never the token itself.
block.microsoft_365.help_tenant_id: Directory used for the token request: common, organizations, consumers, a tenant ID or a domain such as contoso.com.
block.microsoft_365.help_operation: Used when a request gives no operation. Changes need Allow writes; sends also need Allow sending.
block.microsoft_365.help_allowed_operati: JSON array of operation names, for example ["mail_list", "mail_get", "files_list"]. The default operation is always allowed.
block.microsoft_365.help_mail_folder: Folder listed by default and watched for new mail: inbox, archive, sentitems, drafts, deleteditems, junkemail or a folder ID.
block.microsoft_365.help_calendar_id: Empty uses the default calendar. Otherwise the ID of another calendar of the account.
block.microsoft_365.help_drive_folder: OneDrive path listed by default; uploads and new folders always stay inside it. Empty is the drive root.
block.microsoft_365.help_allow_writes: Off by default. Required to send, move or mark mail, change events, upload files, create folders and post to Teams.
block.microsoft_365.help_allow_send: Required for mail_send and channel messages, and for invitations, meeting updates or cancellations that notify attendees.
block.microsoft_365.help_allowed_recipie: JSON array of addresses or @domain entries, for example ["team@example.com", "@example.com"]. Every recipient and attendee must match.
block.microsoft_365.help_allowed_channel: JSON array of "<team id>/<channel id>" entries the block may post to.
block.microsoft_365.help_attachment_root: Mail attachments may only be read from inside this folder (3 MiB in total). Empty refuses attachments.
block.microsoft_365.help_upload_root: Local files may only be uploaded to OneDrive from inside this folder. Required for file_upload.
block.microsoft_365.help_allow_delete: Required for event_delete (the event goes to Deleted Items) and for replacing existing OneDrive files.
block.microsoft_365.help_conflict_behavi: fail refuses the upload, rename keeps both files, replace needs Allow deletion (OneDrive keeps the previous version).
block.microsoft_365.help_folder_exists: reuse returns the existing folder; fail reports a conflict.
block.microsoft_365.help_watch_mail: Active Runtime only: polls the mail folder for new messages while the Run is loaded. One Shot uses the mail_watch operation instead.
block.microsoft_365.help_watch_interval_: Time between two polls, at least 60 seconds.
block.microsoft_365.label_emit_existing: Emit recent mail on first start
block.microsoft_365.help_emit_existing: Off: the first start only records the current position. On: mail received in the last hours below is emitted once.
block.microsoft_365.help_existing_since_: How far back the first start looks when Emit recent mail is on.
block.microsoft_365.help_watch_max_items: Upper bound of new messages emitted by one poll; the rest follow on the next poll.
block.microsoft_365.help_list_limit: Upper bound for one listing; a request limit can only lower it.
block.microsoft_365.help_page_size: Items requested per Graph page. A page is never cut, so next_page_link resumes exactly.
block.microsoft_365.help_max_pages: Graph pages per listing or poll; when reached, the result gives next_page_link to continue.
block.microsoft_365.help_window_days: Length of the events_list window when a request gives no end.
block.microsoft_365.help_time_zone: Time zone of local event times and of returned event times, for example UTC, Europe/Paris or W. Europe Standard Time.
block.microsoft_365.help_body_format: Body returned by mail_get; a request may choose the other format.
block.microsoft_365.help_max_body_chars: Longer bodies are cut and marked truncated in the result.
block.microsoft_365.help_max_attachment_: Per attachment; all attachments of one message stay within 3 MiB.
block.microsoft_365.help_max_upload_byte: Larger files are refused before any request. Files above 4 MB use an upload session.
block.microsoft_365.help_upload_chunk_by: Upload-session fragment size, a multiple of 327680 (320 KiB).
block.microsoft_365.help_max_download_by: Larger files are refused before or during the transfer; a partial file is always removed.
block.microsoft_365.help_max_kept_downlo: Number of downloaded files kept in this node's storage; older downloads are deleted.
block.microsoft_365.help_timeout_sec: Total time for one operation or poll, token request, pages, transfer and retries included.
block.microsoft_365.help_max_retries: Reads retry after HTTP 429, 5xx or a lost connection; changes only after HTTP 429.
block.microsoft_365.help_max_retry_wait_: A Retry-After above this value returns rate_limited instead of waiting.
block.microsoft_365.help_max_request_byt: Bound for the incoming request and each JSON body sent to Graph (sendMail with attachments: 4 MiB).
block.microsoft_365.help_max_response_by: Larger JSON responses are refused as protocol errors (downloads use their own limit).
block.microsoft_365.help_oauth_scope: Scopes sent with the refresh-token request. .default uses the delegated permissions granted to the app.
block.microsoft_365.help_api_base_url: Keep https://graph.microsoft.com. Another origin receives the access token; plain HTTP only for a loopback test host.
block.microsoft_365.help_login_base_url: Keep https://login.microsoftonline.com. Used only with a refresh-token grant; plain HTTP only for a loopback test host.
block.microsoft_365.help_ca_file: Optional absolute PEM file for a privately signed HTTPS origin. TLS verification cannot be disabled.
